name: Delete a database branch
description: Delete a database branch Deletes the specified database branch. DELETE /v1/branches/{branch_id_or_ref}
context:
DELETE /v1/branches/{branch_id_or_ref}
Deletes the specified database branch. By default, deletes immediately. Use force=false to schedule deletion with 1-hour grace period (only when soft deletion is enabled).
Required: branch_id_or_ref (path) — Branch ref or deprecated branch ID
Optional: force (query) — If set to false, schedule deletion with 1-hour grace period (only when soft deletion is enabled).

name: Diffs a database branch
description: Diffs a database branch Diffs the specified database branch This endpoint is currently in its **Beta** stage. GET /v1/branches/{branch_id_or_ref}/diff
context:
GET /v1/branches/{branch_id_or_ref}/diff
Diffs the specified database branch This endpoint is currently in its **Beta** stage.
Required: branch_id_or_ref (path) — Branch ref or deprecated branch ID
Optional: included_schemas (query); pgdelta (query) — Use pg-delta instead of Migra for diffing when true. Boolean string. Truthy values: `true`, `1`, `yes`, `on`, `y`, `enabled` Falsy values: `false`, `0`, `no`, `off`, `n`, `disabled`
